=== short conditional branches, backward and forward
top:
	bc $top
	bnc $top
	bz $fwd
	bnz $fwd
	bh $top
	bnh $fwd
fwd:
	nop
=== unconditional relative branches and calls
start:
	br $start
	br $!start
	call $!start
	br $!later
	call $!later
	br $later
later:
	ret
=== bit tests with short displacements
here:
	bt a.0, $here
	bf a.7, $here
	btclr a.1, $here
	bt 0xffe30.2, $here
	bf 0xfff20.3, $here
	btclr 0xfff10.4, $here
	bt psw.5, $there
	bf [hl].6, $there
	btclr es:[hl].1, $there
	bt es:[hl].2, $there
there:
	nop
=== conditional branch relaxed to the long form
	bc $far
	bnc $far
	bz $far
	bnz $far
	bh $far
	bnh $far
	.space 300
far:
	nop
=== bit tests relaxed to the long form
	bt a.0, $far
	bf a.1, $far
	bt 0xffe30.2, $far
	bf 0xfff20.3, $far
	bt psw.4, $far
	bt [hl].5, $far
	bf es:[hl].6, $far
	.space 300
far:
	nop
=== backward long branches
back:
	.space 300
	bc $back
	bnh $back
	bt a.3, $back
	br $!back
=== edge of the short range, forward, as the reference measures it
	bc $edge
	.space 125
edge:
	nop
=== one past the short range, forward
	bc $edge
	.space 128
edge:
	nop
=== edge of the short range, backward
edge:
	.space 126
	bz $edge
=== data and alignment
	mov a, #1
	.byte 1, 2, 3
	.short 0x1234
	.long 0x12345678
	.balign 4
	ret
	nop
	nop
	nop
=== label differences as immediates and displacements
start:
	nop
	nop
	nop
end:
	movw ax, #end - start
	mov a, #end - start
	mov a, [hl+end-start]
	movw ax, end-start[bc]
=== a relative branch to a label defined by .set
	.set target, .
	nop
	bnz $target
=== equated constants pick the direct-address form
	.set PORT, 0xfff20
	.set FLAGS, 0xffe30
	mov PORT, #1
	mov a, FLAGS
	set1 PORT.3
	bt FLAGS.1, $done
done:
	ret
=== comments and statement separators
	mov a, #1 ; a comment
# a line comment
	mov x, #2 @ mov b, #3
	nop /* block */
